summary.text: Kate Klunk is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 169 since December 1, 2014 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney by profession, she previously worked in the Office of Communications and on the National Economic Council at the White House.

paragraphs.text: Kate Klunk earned a B.A. in history, economics and public policy studies from Dickinson College and a J.D. from the Dickinson School of Law at Pennsylvania State University.

Her professional experience includes working as a private practice attorney, in the White House Office of Communications and on the National Economic Council, as a congressional intern for U.S. Representative Todd Platts, and as a general laborer for Utz Quality Foods.
Klunk took office in the state House in December 2014.
In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the Committee on Ethics and a member of the Professional Licensure and Rules committees.
